summary: Mobile responsive QA for CircZles Player Hub at 360/390/430 across 16 routes. Page-level horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth vs innerWidth) is CLEAN on ALL routes at all three widths — no page horizontal scroll. However, the PRIMARY reported bug is NOT fully fixed: on /hub the player-hero <section> still renders 459px wide (scrollWidth 553px) inside the 390px viewport, causing 'Next: Apprentice' text and the right column of the stat grid (STREAK / PODIUMS) to be clipped by the global overflow-x:hidden. All other components (Reward Wheel, Progression Codex, Avatar Picker, More Sheet, Submission Stepper, Mobile Nav labels, Leaderboard, Desktop 1280) verified fitting correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport, [data-testid='player-hero'] bounding rect is 459px wide (scrollWidth=553) — content overflows to the right by ~69px and is CLIPPED by html/body overflow-x:hidden. 'Next: Apprentice' XP label is cut off (visible as 'Next:'), and the right stat column (STREAK value + PODIUMS block) sits at right=454px, cut off past the 390px viewport. Same behavior at 360px (worse) and 430px (slightly less). The primary reported bug from the task is NOT resolved. Root cause: parent wrapper `<div class='grid gap-6'>` (in /hub layout) has no explicit `grid-cols-1` and no `min-w-0` on its grid items, so the SECTION grid child expands to intrinsic content width instead of stretching within the 358px column. Inside the hero, the descendant `.relative.flex.flex-col.gap-5.sm:flex-row...` also renders 417px wide, indicating internal min-content sizing not being clamped. Fix suggestions: (a) add `grid-cols-1 min-w-0` to the `grid gap-6` parent in /hub page, or (b) apply `min-w-0 w-full` to the player-hero section itself, and (c) ensure the inner flex row wrapper also has `min-w-0`.

action_items: Fix player-hero horizontal overflow at ≤430px: constrain the /hub page's `<div class='grid gap-6'>` wrapper (add grid-cols-1 / min-w-0) and/or apply `w-full min-w-0` to the PlayerHero section and its inner flex row so the XP row and stat grid respect the 390px viewport. Verify 'Next: Apprentice' and PODIUMS render fully within viewport at 360/390/430.
critical_code_review_comments: Global overflow-x:hidden on html/body masks real content clipping — page-level scrollWidth==innerWidth checks alone are NOT sufficient; must also check descendant bounding rects vs innerWidth, which is how this player-hero regression was found.
The `grid gap-6` wrapper in /hub (parent of PlayerHero) is missing an explicit `grid-cols-1` and grid items are missing `min-w-0` — a recurring pattern to guard against on future mobile grids.

PlayerHero inner wrapper `<div class='relative flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-7'>` should include `min-w-0` and its identity child column already has `min-w-0 flex-1` — good, but parent constraint is what's missing.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (15/16 primary checks pass; player-hero fails at 3 widths)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 routes verified for page-level overflow at 360/390/430 — PASS. /activity at 390 had a single navigation timeout (network flake, not overflow). Reward wheel container fits (358x531 at 390; container includes title+wheel+button, not just the SVG). Progression Codex opens as single-column mobile layout with all 9 codex-rank items and codex-close reachable. Avatar Picker opens full-width bottom sheet with close btn. MoreSheet contains all 11 links (Submissions, Rewards, Inventory, Coupons, Seasons, Achievements, Activity, Friends, Notifications, Settings, Admin). Submission Stepper fits at 390. Mobile nav shows 6 items with truncation ('Leaderboa...'). Desktop 1280 sidebar renders correctly. Only unresolved issue is the player-hero overflow on /hub described above.
rca of the issue: Player Hero overflow RCA: parent grid wrapper `<div class='grid gap-6'>` on /hub creates implicit grid tracks; grid items default to `min-width: auto`, so the PlayerHero <section> stretches to its intrinsic content width (~459px) rather than staying inside the 358px column defined by the parent's padded viewport. The global `html,body{overflow-x:hidden}` from globals.css hides the resulting horizontal scrollbar but does NOT prevent the visual clipping of 'Next: Apprentice' and the right stat column. Reproduction: viewport 390x844 → /hub → inspect [data-testid='player-hero'] boundingClientRect → right=475 (>390). Mitigation: add `grid-cols-1` and `min-w-0` on the /hub grid wrapper, and/or `w-full min-w-0` on the PlayerHero <section>.
